_comment: An agent may NOT remove a component, add an external prerequisite, or add an
entry to approved_deviations. Those require an explicit user-approved
deviation request under Part 0.7. Versions marked PIN_AT_BUILD are pinned
during Phase -1 after compatibility and security testing; pinning a version
is ordinary work, removing a component is not.

required_components.forbidden_substitute: system Python, py launcher, Microsoft Store Python, first-run download

required_components.capability: low-level execution of the exact packaged wheels
required_components.delivery: bundled or proven in the approved Windows image
required_components.forbidden_substitute: assuming the build PC's Visual C++ state exists everywhere

required_components.capability: controlled Excel desktop automation over COM
trusted local history and analytical SQL
required_components.forbidden_substitute: CSV/JSON files, browser storage, Excel sheets, in-memory-only history

required_components.delivery: bundled through the verified DuckDB build
required_components.forbidden_substitute: unversioned CSV dump, or no recovery archive when policy permits one

required_components.capability: typed loopback API, validated uploads, durable progress
required_components.forbidden_substitute: static HTML-only product, ad-hoc file server, batch-script workflow

required_components.delivery: bundled process; 127.0.0.1; asInvoker; OS-selected or bounded high port
required_components.forbidden_substitute: LAN/public bind, file:// application, direct browser access to COM/DB/files, Windows Service, IIS/HTTP.sys, firewall or URL-reservation change, administrator requirement

required_components.capability: professional interactive charts with accessible summaries
required_components.forbidden_substitute: CDN, online chart service, screenshot-only charts, reduced chart set

required_components.delivery: hash-locked, in the project/update kit only
required_components.forbidden_substitute: employee runtime repair via pip, live package index, unverified copied environment

required_components.delivery: proven part of the approved Windows image, or packaged WebView2 Fixed Version
required_components.forbidden_substitute: online bootstrapper, assuming the browser is probably installed

required_components.capability: agent onboarding, map freshness and token control
required_components.delivery: bundled in the project/update kit, isolated from the user runtime
required_components.forbidden_substitute: deleting the map or skill to reduce package size

optional_components.capability: central synchronization when explicitly enabled and approved
optional_components.delivery: bundled with native prerequisites when enabled
optional_components.disabled_reason: Part 13.4: skip until someone outside the team needs the data. Phase 6 is NOT_APPLICABLE until enabled.
Part 37.2 rule 4: absence degrades to stdlib AST parsing and is never a failure.
optional_components.forbidden_substitute: making the map engine fail when it is absent
